editorial:
Imagine being kidnapped by a sweet-looking old couple who seem like they should be baking cookies, but instead, they are into dark magic. You will feel the tension right away as you follow a pregnant woman trapped in a house with two grandparents who are desperate to bring their dead grandson back to life. They want to put his soul into her unborn baby using a creepy old book. The vibe is very tense and makes you feel trapped right along with the main character, making you wonder just how far people will go when they lose someone they love.

What really works here is the acting, especially the couple who play the villains. They are scary because they seem so normal at first. The plot has some wild turns that you won't see coming, though the middle part slows down a bit. If you like scary movies that focus on family secrets and magic, you will love this one.
endingExplained: In the end, the spell goes horribly wrong. Instead of bringing back their grandson, the couple opens a door for a demonic entity. The demon takes over and causes total chaos in the house. The pregnant woman manages to fight back and survive the nightmare, while the grandparents pay a heavy price for their greed. It wraps up with the realization that some things are meant to stay dead and messing with magic always has a cost.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological thrillers and occult horror.
